claims.claim: A valid opposite-label T1 pair is exactly merged by the legacy independently sorted feature representation.
claims.allowed_wording: The specified T1 pair has opposite oracle labels and exactly equal legacy sorted features in float32 and float64; the legal whole-orbit feature separates this pair.
claims.forbidden_wording: The legacy representation globally loses all T1 label information; this establishes a positive collision rate in random T1 populations.
claims.recomputation: The pair, oracle, and dtype-specific feature gap were checked in the archived record; the CPU recomputation script is provided but no final combined receipt was emitted.
claims.limitations: One constructed witness does not estimate prevalence or establish task-wide impossibility. M1-only recomputation output produced at closeout; independent acceptance NOT_COMPLETED. New square-tie test has no completed execution receipt; no new inference promoted.

claims.claim: The source G8 finite-bank and local searches exclude exact opposite-label collisions.
claims.allowed_wording: The exact nearest opposite-label distance in the enumerated positive-margin bank was 0.0471; a bounded 3,000-step local search found a best sampled distance of 0.0335 and no sampled exact merge.
claims.forbidden_wording: The positive local-search distance is a lower bound; no exact collision exists in the continuous source task.
claims.denominator: 4,096 finite-bank scenes and 3,000 sampled local-search candidates
claims.recomputation: The recorded search values were inspected; continuous/global search was not run.
claims.limitations: The finite-bank nearest pair is exact only for that enumerated bank. The random local search is incomplete. M1-only recomputation output produced at closeout; independent acceptance NOT_COMPLETED. New square-tie test has no completed execution receipt; no new inference promoted.
fixes: Corrected current source wording: a positive best-observed distance is not a lower bound. Historical JSON remains immutable.

claims.claim: The source orbit representation applies one legal permutation to the whole distance vector and is invariant under the legal source group.
claims.allowed_wording: The implementation uses a whole-orbit lexicographic representative and existing tests check scalar parity and legal-group invariance. The saved seam tie fraction may undercount exact duplicate minima.
claims.forbidden_wording: The old seam-rate JSON accurately measures all lexicographic ties.
claims.denominator: Existing unit tests plus archived M1 states; no new full-bank parity receipt in this closeout
claims.recomputation: Current tie logic now counts candidates equal to the lexicographic minimum. A square counterexample motivated the regression test; the added M1 test was not run in this closeout.
claims.limitations: The corrected tie rate is not present in the immutable historical seam JSON. M1-only recomputation output produced at closeout; independent acceptance NOT_COMPLETED. New square-tie test has no completed execution receipt; no new inference promoted.
fixes: Changed tie counting from componentwise minima to duplicate lexicographic minima.

claims.claim: Orbit-distance has no accuracy price versus sorted features and gains robustly under flip supervision.
claims.allowed_wording: The archive reports positive clean-setting point contrasts on the frozen bank. Flip orbit-minus-sorted point differences were +0.0654, +0.0005, and -0.0311 across the three seeds; the last two archived intervals cross zero.
claims.forbidden_wording: Orbit-distance has no accuracy cost across all supervision regimes; it consistently beats sorted features under flips.
claims.denominator: 2,188 quartets / 871 parents; 3 training seeds; separate clean and flip conditions
claims.recomputation: Archived selected predictions exist for all 36 cells. A final row-weighted contrast receipt was not emitted; historical intervals use equal-parent means while their displayed point estimates are row-weighted.
claims.limitations: Do not promote the clean point pattern to a universal no-cost claim until the matching row-weighted cluster intervals are accepted. M1-only recomputation output produced at closeout; independent acceptance NOT_COMPLETED. New square-tie test has no completed execution receipt; no new inference promoted.
fixes: Current evaluator labels the historical equal-parent CI estimand and emits a separate row-weighted cluster interval.

claims.denominator: 685 distinct quartets / 351 parents; archived 692 rows include 7 exact repeats; 3 training seeds share one bank
claims.recomputation: Completed: independent saved-prediction metrics and parent bootstrap; selected-checkpoint tensor audit; true-geometry CPU replay. No retraining.
limitations: One previously evaluated bank and renderer; 3 training seeds are not 3 independent datasets.
Geometry frontends receive privileged coordinate-derived supervision; direct models receive relation labels. Equal image exposures are not equal information or matched objectives.
Tuning changes both learnable weights and BatchNorm behavior; this is a bundled recipe contrast.
Predicted six-distance vectors are unconstrained; physical-validity and error-matched interface interventions were not run.
No cross-renderer validation or proof of global unlearnability.
Full ResNet forward replay of every image is not run; accepted predictions are checked against hashes, labels, metrics, selected checkpoint tensors, and training receipts.
claims.claim: Actual backbone tuning improves the fixed-head pipeline.
claims.allowed_wording: On 685 distinct quartets from 351 parents, unfreezing the geometry-prediction backbone raises J3 from 0.153–0.182 to 0.342–0.455. Paired per-seed parent-cluster intervals for gains of 0.188–0.273 exclude zero. The fixed source-head pipeline remains substantially below direct visual classification (J3 0.893–0.917) under the tested recipes. These results support a learnable adaptation benefit, not module superiority or an unlearnable interface.
claims.forbidden_wording: Unfreezing has no effect; global unlearnability; capacity excluded.
